title: Auto Loans: does the relationship discount apply when a loan is enrolled in autopay?
content:
# Auto Loans: does the relationship discount apply when a loan is enrolled in autopay?

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts. It decides whether the checking relationship discount enters the enrolled APR.

## Clause

The relationship discount is confirmed from the borrower's checking records. It applies when, on the loan's funding date, the borrower held a checking account of one of the product's qualifying tiers: one of those accounts was opened on or before the funding date and was not closed on or before the funding date. A qualifying account closed later still counts, and one opened after the funding date never counts. When it applies, its size is the product's relationship discount; when it does not, no relationship discount enters the enrolled APR.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Inputs**: the loan's funding date; for each checking account of a qualifying tier, its opening date and, if any, its closing date.
- **Judgement**: opened on or before the funding date, and either never closed or closed after the funding date.
- **Output**: the relationship discount applies if any such account passes; otherwise it does not.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical loan funded 2025-06-10)

| Qualifying account opened | Closed | Discount applies? |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-06-10 | never | yes: opened on the funding date |
| 2024-01-20 | 2025-06-10 | no: closed on the funding date |
| 2024-01-20 | 2025-06-11 | yes: closed the day after |
| 2025-06-11 | never | no: opened the day after |

## Points of judgement

**Is the relationship discount decided by whether the qualifying account is still open today?** No. Only the position on the funding date matters: a qualifying account closed after the funding date still counts.
